content.short: The Unfrgtn is a multichain holder verification tool that token-gates Discord servers.
content.description: The Unfrgtn checks token and NFT holdings across chains to control access to Discord communities. Token gating is one of the few NFT utilities that stayed useful after the speculative cycle ended, because communities genuinely need a membership check.
content.meta: Checks token and NFT holdings across chains to control access to Discord communities.
